research_notes: 2026-10-01 avenues: detailed primary chambers CV, ALP biography, indexed WA appointment Hansard, professional directory; searches for full-time status and World Bank personnel evidence. Primary CV corrects simplified secondary accounts: KWM began 2014; senior-associate promotion 1 July 2015; firm role ends 2017 before 2018 Bar entry.

Obtain exact appointments/cessations, full-time hours and leave for Mallesons, White & Case and KWM; resolve 2010–11 study/training overlap and 2013–14 transitions. Check any earlier paid work before 2007.
Obtain World Bank consultant contract, workload and payer; intergovernmental institution is publicly controlled, but consultant versus employee and headline treatment remain unresolved.

Confirm barrister practice cessation/suspension in 2024 and substantive workload; clarify university sessional/adjunct remuneration and continuing dates, Australian Book Review paid writing, and governance remuneration/overlap. Year labels are not exact durations; ongoing CV dates apply to 2023, not automatically to snapshot.

Follow-up 2026-10-02: primary chambers farewell and first speech enrich month-level Bar commencement and corroborate late-2014 return; retained 2014 KWM start and separate July 2015 promotion. Added party presidencies as excluded roles, not salaried legal work.

Targeted World Bank personnel/consultant, Global Voices reports and full-time searches did not establish individual contract or hours. Global Voices 2020 financial report index corroborates background but did not resolve workload. Long hours and a full career do not prove full-time status.

Next follow-up: World Bank appointment/contract record, law-firm employment dates and hours, chambers final practice date, UWA teaching appointments and ABR remuneration terms. No Senate appointment proxy used for legal cessation.

Follow-up 2026-10-03: targeted World Bank personnel/document, White & Case and KWM searches yielded no attributable primary appointment record or hours evidence. World Bank results were older insolvency publications or other people named Varun/Ghosh; they were not attributed. Existing first-person/CV chronology remains the strongest evidence. Advance to the next member while retaining contract, workload, exact transition and practice-cessation gaps.

Follow-up2026-10-04: Targeted law-firm promotion, World Bank document/personnel, Pegasus placement and personal full-time queries retrieved the existing 2023 chambers CV and broad biographies but no contract/workload or exact cessation evidence. Current first-person website https://varunghosh.com.au/ corroborates existing employers without dates or hours; 2025 Australia India Youth Dialogue public profile similarly repeats the chronology. SBS Document-1.pdf briefing repeats a simplified 2015 Perth return; it is not preferred over the recorded personal late-2014 account and dated CV promotion. Electorate-officer full-time job ads concern his staff, not his earlier legal employment. Retain World Bank payer/status, study/US transitions, chambers practice cessation and hours gaps; advance without changing supported facts.
